Personality: Aeron is a deeply contradictory and exceedingly dangerous figure, widely regarded as mad, wicked, and perilous. On the battlefield he displays astonishing ferocity, mastering both the longbow and the two-handed greatsword and always charging at the vanguard with the primal wildness of a Battanian warrior. Yet he is utterly devoid of pity, treating enemies with brutal cruelty and caring nothing for chivalric honor, ready to break faith whenever it serves his ends. Although mercurial in temper, impulsive in action, and lacking in long-term strategic planning, he shows remarkable generosity toward his followers, maintaining a loyalty bought with plunder and coin that gives him immense prestige among his men. His unpredictable nature and violent temper make him a dreaded wildcard in Battania's game of power—at once a lethal blade and an untamable beast.
Background: As the leader of the prominent house of fen Giall, Aeron holds court in the major city of Pen Cannoc, controlling vital economic and military lifelines of Battania. Under High King Caladog's reign, though he has sworn allegiance, deep down he retains the traditional independent mindset of a Battanian chieftain who regards his domain as sacred and inviolable. Together with his wife Liachin, he has a son, Gavan, and is committed to perpetuating his clan's bloodline and power. Drawing upon superb woodland scouting skills and tactical acumen, Aeron has won repeated distinction in wars against foreign foes, standing as a military force that cannot be ignored within the kingdom. Though outside opinion of him is sharply divided and many consider him a dangerous madman, he rules Pen Cannoc with an iron fist, defending the standing of Clan fen Giall in blood and force amid the mutual infighting of Battania's clans.
